scenarios.title: Signature and attestations minted by a different workflow of the same repository on main
scenarios.expected_rule: none — the pinned identity's workflow path is a wildcard
scenarios.detail: signed, SBOM-attested and provenance-attested entirely by evasion-tests.yml; the release pipeline never ran for this image

evidence.note: the pinned subject wildcards the workflow path, so any workflow of this repository on main can mint an admissible artefact
